baseline: stage1 floor DiffPTS pq; reuse successful result, never retrain here

state_features.transform: sign(v)*log1p(abs(v)) applied to each feature; bank input units retained; Q fixed-fit-Q95 normalized and P inherited-fit-P-scale normalized; no newly fitted feature scaling
state_features.state_q: all six P slots zero; original mean backbone still receives identical historical P/Q

zero_initialization: all three output heads weight/bias zero; baseline constructed first at same seed
variance: a=g+log(-expm1(-g)); g_new=softplus(a+residual).clamp_min(1e-8); same resulting g enters NLL/noise/sampling; zero residual recovers original within floating tolerance without blocking head gradients
denoiser: residual broadcast over future hours, added after author's lin1 timestep multiplication and before original softplus; no future-time convolution
loss: unchanged stage1 author joint GaussianNLL + denoise noise MSE
resampling: preserve country/canonical station at every original exposure position; within station allocate half exposures per future-fit-Q95 ever-exceed class if both exist (odd remainder randomized), then event/segment uniformly, then origin uniformly; one class fallback explicit
